subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Let us __adjourn__ the meeting here, as it is lunchtime now.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Postpone**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"adjourn"** means to break off (a meeting, legal case, or game) with the intention of resuming it later; it is often used in the context of formal meetings or assemblies. (स्थगित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The chairperson decided to adjourn the meeting until the following week due to the absence of key members.
 
 

 
• **"Postpone" **refers to causing or arranging for (something) to take place at a time later than that first scheduled. It conveys a similar meaning of delaying something to a later time. (स्थगित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Due to unforeseen circumstances, we had to postpone our plans for the picnic until next month.
 
 

 
• Therefore, **"Postpone"** is the most appropriate synonym for **"adjourn"** in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Postpone**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prohibit **(निषेध करना): To formally forbid (something) by law, rule, or other authority.
 
 
• **Example:** The new policy will prohibit smoking in all public areas.
 
 

 
• **Stimulate **(उत्तेजित करना ): To raise levels of physiological or nervous activity in (the body or any biological system).
 
 
• **Example: **Coffee can stimulate the nervous system, making you feel more awake and alert.
 
 

 
• **Expedite** (शीघ्रता करना): To make (an action or process) happen sooner or be accomplished more quickly.
 
 
• **Example:** We've requested the courier service to expedite the delivery of our package.
